consequence.statement: The fix is labelled fix(ci) and only changes the compatibility table generator in the project's CI, so operators need to do nothing.

assertion.statement: This is a CI-only fix to the compatibility table generator so that it handles major versions; it has no operational consequence for an Argo CD deployment.
